fields.label: Include Monthly Employees in Second-Quincena Payroll
fields.description: Get Employees includes Monthly and Bimonthly assignments in a Bimonthly payroll from the 15th or 16th through month end. Monthly employees receive full-calendar-month Salary Slips in the same Payroll Entry. First-quincena and timesheet payrolls are unchanged.
Total weekly-hours threshold at which overtime changes from +35% to +100%. Example: 68 with 44 expected hours permits 24 hours at +35%.
fields.label: Max Weekly Extra Hours

fields.description: Especifique el monto por cada dependiente inscrito en el seguro para hacer la correcta deducción en la nómina.
fields.label: Monto por Dependiente

fields.description: Legacy mode keeps balanced excluded Salary Component rows. Dedicated mode stores employer contributions separately and posts them directly in the payroll accrual Journal Entry.
fields.label: Employer Contribution Accounting Mode
fields.options:
Salary Component Pairs
Dedicated Journal Entries

fields.description: Monthly employer INFOTEP percentage. Law 116-80 establishes 1% of salary payroll; commissions are included by the TSS reporting guide.
fields.label: INFOTEP Employer Rate

fields.description: Company-specific SRL percentage. The DEV default reflects the 1.20% rate used in IGC payroll from February 2025 onward and must be reconciled to the production TSS classification.
fields.label: SRL Employer Rate

fields.description: Enable only after reconciling the configured SRL percentage to IGC's current TSS notification or pre-liquidation.
fields.label: SRL Rate Verified Against TSS

fields.description: Feature gate for approved overtime records and punch reconciliation. Approved Cash retroactive adjustments create linked Additional Salary earnings; Compensatory Rest remains separate.
fields.label: Enable Overtime Authorization

fields.description: Enables explicit settlement actions after attendance reconciliation. Deployment does not activate this setting.
fields.label: Enable Overtime Settlement

fields.default:
HR Manager
Accounts Manager
System Manager
fields.description: One Frappe role per line. A user must also be able to read the source overtime record.
fields.label: Settlement Roles

fields.description: Smallest leave-day credit posted to the consolidated allocation. Remaining hours stay in the overtime bank.
fields.label: Leave Credit Increment

fields.description: When enabled, an hourly idempotent job creates review-only candidates from Employee Checkins. It never creates payroll, Additional Salary, leave, or accounting records.
fields.label: Enable Overtime Candidate Generation

fields.description: Minimum delay after the scheduled shift end before a regular-workday candidate is surfaced. Legal holidays are always evaluated.
fields.label: Candidate Threshold (Minutes)

fields.description: Number of completed calendar days reevaluated by each hourly run. Existing candidates are updated idempotently until a supervisor makes a final decision.
fields.label: Candidate Lookback Days

fields.default:
Operador
Auxiliar
Mecánico
Electricista
Inspector
Prensista
Troquelador
fields.description: One designation keyword per line. Matching active plant employees are surfaced as Eligibility Pending until Overtime Eligible and Approver are configured.
fields.label: Plant Designation Keywords

fields.description: Temporary exception gate for approving already-worked overtime from Employee Checkins. Keep disabled outside the controlled historical cleanup period.
fields.label: Enable Retroactive Overtime Adjustment

fields.description: Earliest Work Date that may be submitted as a retroactive adjustment.
fields.label: Retroactive Overtime From Date

fields.description: Latest historical Work Date that may be submitted as a retroactive adjustment.
fields.label: Retroactive Overtime To Date

fields.description: Last calendar date on which an approver may submit a historical adjustment. After this date, the exception path closes automatically.
fields.label: Retroactive Overtime Submission Deadline
Enable Manual Overtime Verification
fields.description: Allow configured roles to certify completed attendance without requiring Employee Checkins. Settlement remains a separate action.

fields.label: Manual Overtime Verification Roles
fields.description: One existing Desk role per line. Users also need write permission on the authorization and its Work Call. No role, including System Manager, bypasses this list.

fields.label: Enable Automatic Work Call Settlement
fields.description: New Work Calls using Follow Settings are enrolled on submission. Existing calls require explicit enrollment. Attendance is presumed; no Employee Checkins are required. Both settlement methods run after each authorized window ends.

fields.label: Overtime Attendance Exception Roles
fields.description: One enabled Desk role per line. Assigned employee approvers can also record exceptions. Corrections remain available when automatic processing is paused.

fields.label: Automatic Cash Payroll Date Policy
fields.options:
Work Date
Month End
Work Call Date
fields.description: Frozen on enrollment. Work Call Date requires an explicit date on the Work Call, on or after its last work date.

fields.label: Procesar marcaciones desde
fields.description: Solo autoriza inscripciones nuevas desde esta fecha. No convierte las convocatorias antiguas de asistencia presumida.

fields.label: Vigilar cambios en evidencia de horas extras
fields.description: Comprueba evidencia inscrita, ajustes retroactivos y nocturnidad. Crea seguimiento; no modifica horas aprobadas, pagos ni licencias. Sigue disponible aunque se pause la creación de pagos.

fields.label: Vigilar incidencias de jornada
fields.description: Comprueba periódicamente incidencias guardadas, incluso resueltas, con los permisos actuales de su responsable. No cambia pagos.

fields.label: Avisos internos de incidencias de jornada
fields.description: Avisa al responsable de casos abiertos o descansos previstos vencidos pendientes de revisión. Respeta sus preferencias; no envía correo.

fields.label: Días entre recordatorios de incidencia
fields.description: Cero desactiva recordatorios repetidos; conserva avisos por evidencia modificada o reasignación. De 0 a 30 días.

fields.label: Vigilar descanso compensatorio
fields.description: Comprueba elecciones aprobadas, crédito, licencia y respaldo de disfrute. No modifica saldos ni pagos.

fields.label: Avisos internos de descanso compensatorio
fields.description: Avisa al responsable sobre programación pendiente, vencimiento o evidencia que requiere revisión; sin correo.

fields.label: Días entre recordatorios de descanso compensatorio
fields.description: De cero a treinta días. Cero conserva solo avisos por cambios de estado, evidencia o responsable.

fields.label: Publicar reglas al guardar
fields.description: Guardar publica una versión para la empresa y vigencia indicadas. No crea pagos ni activa el scheduler. Apagar esta opción detiene la publicación desde Configuración; no cancela las reglas ya aprobadas.

fields.label: Versión de partida / última publicación
fields.description: Para revisar reglas existentes, seleccione su versión vigente y cárguela. Cada cambio conserva la versión anterior.

fields.label: Motivo del cambio
fields.description: Opcional. Se registra junto con el usuario que guarda y publica las reglas.

fields.label: Aplicar el recargo nocturno a toda la jornada nocturna
fields.description: Apagado: solo trabajo de 21:00 a 07:00. Encendido: toda la jornada evidenciada si acumula al menos tres horas nocturnas. Aplica el recargo nocturno; las horas ordinarias no se convierten en horas extra.

fields.label: Umbral de horas reales semanales
fields.description: Suma de horas trabajadas de lunes a domingo. Los recargos se suman sobre la hora base: 35% + 15% = 50%, sin capitalización.

fields.label: Liquidar también nocturnidad ordinaria al procesar una autorización
fields.description: Requiere una autorización inscrita con liquidación automática y evidencia completa. No procesa empleados sin autorización inscrita.

fields.label: Permitir pago por descanso semanal trabajado
Permitir descanso compensatorio en estas reglas
Fracción mínima de licencia
fields.description: Medio día (0.5) o día completo (1).

fields.label: Horas de descanso por hora compensada
Crédito de licencia por descanso semanal
fields.description: Equivalencia con el banco de licencia. Vacío mantiene este caso pendiente de revisión.

fields.label: Feriado y descanso semanal: pago en efectivo
fields.options:
Require review
Single highest premium
Additive premiums
fields.description: Require review: mantener pendiente. Single highest premium: aplicar una vez el mayor recargo. Additive premiums: sumar ambos recargos sobre la misma base. No sustituye la elección del empleado; el descanso compensatorio requiere separar obligaciones.
